'''Aborah''' was an island in the [[Western Sea (Muunilinst)|Western Sea]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The island was a dormant [[smoker]], underneath which lay a number of interconnected lava tubes, remnants of its violent, volcanic past. For generations Aborah was the province of the [[Damask clan]].

As [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], Damask conducted experiments at his private residence on the Island in the search for eternal life, and had an extensive laboratory complex hidden behind his mansion.
